meta.title: Donate · המשך תנועה
meta.description: Your gift keeps regular meetings going for combat veterans: give once or monthly, fund a Friday meeting, give as a company, or give from abroad.

hero.title: Support our work
hero.body: Donations let us hold regular meetings for combat veterans, and move toward community centers across Israel.
hero.partners: Partner as a company or organization

ways.title: Ways to give
ways.body: Choose the way that suits you. You can arrange any gift with us on WhatsApp.

oneTime.title: One-time gift
oneTime.body: A single gift, in any amount that feels right to you.
oneTime.message: Hi, I'd like to make a one-time donation to המשך תנועה.

monthly.title: Monthly gift
monthly.body: A steady gift every month. Like our meetings: here for the long run.
monthly.wa: Arrange a monthly gift on WhatsApp
monthly.message: Hi, I'd like to set up a monthly donation to המשך תנועה.

sponsor.title: Fund a Friday meeting
sponsor.body: Cover a full Friday morning: the workout, the coffee and the talk.
sponsor.wa: Talk to us about funding a meeting
sponsor.message: Hi, I'd like to hear about funding a Friday meeting of המשך תנועה.

company.title: Corporate giving
company.body: Companies and organizations can donate, sponsor a meeting or build a partnership with us.

abroad.title: Giving from abroad
abroad.body: Giving from outside Israel? Write to us and we'll find the best way together.
abroad.message: Hi, I'd like to give to המשך תנועה from outside Israel.

tax.title: Section 46: application in process
tax.body: Our application for Section 46 recognition, which gives Israeli taxpayers a tax credit, is in process. We'll update this page when there's a decision.
tax.approved: We are recognized under Section 46 of the Israeli Income Tax Ordinance: gifts from Israeli taxpayers qualify for a tax credit under the law.

trust.title: Who's behind it
trust.body: The team and board who run the meetings and lead the way toward the community centers.

closing.title: You don't have to give to be part of this
closing.body: You can volunteer, give a talk, or simply send the link to a friend you served with.
closing.propose: Offer a talk or a workout session

slots.oneTimeUrl: payment page link for one-time gifts (org.json: donateUrl)
slots.sponsorAmount: cost of funding one Friday meeting, if public (org.json: sponsorAmount)
slots.abroad: how to give from abroad: receiving entity, currencies, tax receipt in the donor's country, link (org.json: abroad)
slots.bank: bank account details, only if public (org.json: bank)
slots.stats: 3–4 numbers you can prove: number, short label, period (org.json: stats)
slots.impact: where gifts go: 3 lines with real amounts or shares (org.json: impact)
slots.quotes: 2–3 participant quotes, with written consent (org.json: quotes)
slots.team: names and roles of the team and board (org.json: team, board)
slots.registration: legal name and amuta registration number (org.json: registrationNumber)
slots.reports: financial and activity reports, proper-conduct certificate (org.json: reports, properConduct)

stat.label: young men and women complete combat service every year

volunteer.title: Volunteer with us
volunteer.lead: Our meetings happen because people give their time: on the Friday welcome team, with a talk or by leading a workout.
